{{Top|leg}}
'''Caldera's Crest''' was a guerrilla group based on [[New Bornalex/Legends|New Bornalex]], which was aligned to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Its members were trained by [[Auren Yomm Baobab|Auren Yomm]] in survival techniques and how to handle [[bluffbeast]]s.
